# Version 4.158.0
> **Skia and HarfBuzz updates** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 pairs Skia m158 rendering updates with HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and expanded script constants. GPU corrections cover hairlines, text atlases, clip recording and displacement sampling. The collected changes also strengthen per-process hash seeding without changing hash-code stability within a process.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 158** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158 and incorporates subsequent same-milestone native fixes without changing SkiaSharp's public managed signatures. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634), [#5702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5702))

## API Surface

- **HarfBuzz 15 and complete named scripts** — Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 HarfBuzzSharp Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing constants, struct-based parsing and numeric conversions are preserved. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct GPU sampling and clip limits** — Fixes reflected zero-length hairline caps and text-atlas selection. Displacement offsets now match float-precision filter bounds. Graphite accounts for pending clips and logs and skips draws whose clip stacks cannot fit a fresh pass. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669), [#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))
- **Vulkan device-loss and synchronous waits** — Adds a 1 ms device-loss teardown delay for ARM proprietary drivers >=42 and <56. Native synchronous submission now reports fence-wait failures internally; GRContext.Submit remains void, with no new managed failure result and no change to asynchronous submission. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669), [#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **OS-generated hash seeds** — The shared HashCode implementation uses the OS cryptographic random generator for its per-process seed. Hashes remain randomized between processes and stable within one process; first use now also loads cryptography support. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script values, parsing and numeric conversions remain intact; no public managed member is removed.

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Preview 2 updates HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants. It also corrects reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip limits, with targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup timing.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m158 without changing managed APIs. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while the native HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.
